seat_alert_body: The seatbox is open. Lock anyways skips the seatbox wait and requests normal shutdown. The seatbox will remain unsecured until you close it.
home_lock_override_unknown: Lock request outcome unknown. Check the scooter’s status before trying again.
home_lock_override_unavailable: Could not check seatbox override support. No lock request was sent.
home_lock_override_expired: The lock request expired before acceptance. Check the scooter’s status.
home_lock_override_unsafe: The scooter rejected the request. Park it before locking.
home_lock_override_unsupported: This firmware does not support locking with an open seatbox. Close the seatbox or update the scooter firmware.
home_lock_accepted: Shutdown request accepted. Check the scooter’s lock status.
onboarding_step6_body: Give your scooter a name and pick a colour.
